lessons.goal: 比較靜態教材與現場更新，找有效路線。

questions.evidence: Audio-walk chat: The recording says to cross the stone bridge after the fountain, but a sign today shows that the bridge is closed for repairs. Should we continue because the recording is part of the official route? The map on my phone was downloaded last month.
options: Because all maps are free.
Because the garden has disappeared.
For the audio recording.
For repairs.
questions.prompt: Why is the stone bridge closed?

options: A path with no destination.
The closed stone bridge.
The wooden footbridge farther north.
The route beneath the repair equipment.
questions.prompt: Which route does the guide recommend?

questions.evidence:
Audio-walk chat: The recording says to cross the stone bridge after the fountain, but a sign today shows that the bridge is closed for repairs. Should we continue because the recording is part of the official route? The map on my phone was downloaded last month.

Guide: Follow the current closure sign. Use the wooden footbridge farther north, which the temporary map marks with a blue arrow. It reaches the same reading garden, though it adds about five minutes to the usual walk.

Walker: The audio mentions a statue after the old bridge. Will we miss that story? Guide: You can listen to the statue recording at the garden. Do not enter a closed path just to stand at the original listening point.

The group follows the detour and notes the changed route in its trip record. Before recommending the walk to friends, they will check whether the repair is finished. An accurate account of today's walk should not be treated as a permanent route for every future visitor.
questions.explanation: 錄音為較早資訊，應遵現場現行封閉。
options: A downloaded map always predicts future closures.
The sign changes the statue's history.
Every official recording is deliberately false.
It may describe an older route before current repairs.
questions.prompt: Why doesn't the official recording override the closure sign?

options: Drawn only in pencil.

Intended for a limited period.

options: Delete the story because its location changed.
Enter the closed path to reach the old point.
Play that recording at the garden.
Wait on the stone bridge for repairs.

options: A guarantee that today's route lasts forever.
Only whether the old file can still be opened.
Whether the temporary repair and detour still apply.
The color of last month's phone case.
